current_evidence: Not verified: the shared WebFetch budget (400/hour) was exhausted and returned HTTP 403 on 3 attempts, and the WebSearch budget for this turn was used up, so neither the checklist PDF nor the supporting-information page could be fetched.

issues.detail: List date 2026-07-01 is taken from PDF metadata CreationDate, not from a date printed in the checklist or on the supporting-information page.

Forest of Dean publishes a separate validation checklist for each application type. The workbook link points only to the Full Planning Permission checklist. Grokbot never read the Householder, Outline/Reserved matters, Listed Building Consent, Advertisement or Approval of Details checklists, yet marks Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement consent and Discharge of conditions as '(none) - national requirements only'. Those types are unaudited, not national-only.
issues.evidence: Page text in tab_items: 'Householder Planning Permission - pdf - 364 Kb', 'Listed Building Consent Form - pdf - 384 Kb', 'Consent To Display An Advertisement - pdf - 278 Kb', 'Approval Of Details Reserved By A Condition - pdf - 220 Kb'; none appear in docs_read

issues.detail: Every 'Listed building consent' row comes from the Removal or Variation of a Condition (s73) checklist (media/0hjeydvi), not an LBC checklist. They are exact duplicates of the s73 rows (BNG, Block plan, CIL, Site levels, Floor plans/Elevations, Planning Statement, Pre-app, Roof plan, Self-build). Real LBC requirements, such as a Heritage Statement and joinery details, are not captured under LBC.

Older dated versions were read alongside the current undated files. The Lawful development certificate rows are sourced only from 'lawful-development-existing-use-fod-7-11-2022.pdf' and 'lawful-development-proposed-use-fod-24-05-23.pdf'. Older copies of the s73 and NMA checklists ('...-fod-25-11-2022.pdf', '...-fod-7-11-2022.pdf') were also read and fed submission-rule items. These may be superseded versions.

The CIL Additional Information Form is listed under Listed building consent and s73 with a boilerplate trigger. The checklist text itself says only West Oxfordshire and Cotswold have adopted CIL charging schedules, which implies the CIL form does not apply in Forest of Dean. That CIL paragraph is also pasted into the 'Existing and proposed site levels' trigger.
issues.evidence: 'Development may be liable for a charge under CIL if the Council has chosen to set a charge in its area, currently West Oxfordshire District Council and Cotswolds District Council have adopted CIL charging schedules.'

issues.detail: Many triggers are fragments or come from the wrong row. Retail Impact Assessment: 'Desirable for a variation of an existing legal agreement' (Heads of Terms text). Block plan: carries the Roof plan trigger ('Where any roof is being altered...'). Floor plans/Elevations under Full: the 1:5 and 1:1 joinery-detail scales, which are listed-building window and door details. Fire Statement: runs into Design and Access Statement text. Fragments with no trigger: 'countryside Supporting Planning Statement', 'of the pre-application advice process.', 'to the Heritage Statement requirement.', 'carry out a Habitats Regulations Assessments (HRA).'. Archaeology and BNG rows quote methodology text, not when the item is required.
issues.evidence: Retail row: 'Retail Impact Assessment What information is required? Desirable for a variation of an existing legal agreement.'

issues.detail: Nearly all 21 'Submission rules' tab items are not requirements. They include web-page link text with file sizes ('Householder Planning Permission - pdf - 364 Kb ...'), GDPR text ('We will only use your personal information...'), 'Once the application has been registered, any further supporting information must be emailed', the 30mb upload limit, checklist column headings ('Is it required for my application?', '2 National requirements') and page numbers.
issues.evidence: 'We will only use your personal information gathered for the specific purposes of your application/enquiry.'

issues.detail: The page footer 'All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format, ideally as PDF documents and not in draft format.' is appended to about 12 different tab items. 'All drawings must include a title, drawing number, confirmation of the scale and a scale bar' appears three times under drawing standards.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'A schedule/layout of homes All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format...'

issues.detail: The district's own local Biodiversity requirement (a Biodiversity Self-Assessment Form submitted with supporting documents) is captured only as link text under 'Submission rules'. It has no requirement row and no trigger, and is absent from Householder and Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'Our biodiversity requirement asks an applicant to submit a self-assessment form as part of their supporting documentation.'

issues.detail: The Full planning set has only 11 rows. Items that Grokbot's own extracted text shows are in the Full checklist have no row: a tree survey / arboricultural information (trees and hedges within falling distance), Heads of Terms / planning obligations, an Ecological Impact Assessment as a Full requirement, and a schedule/layout of homes (housing mix / affordable housing). The rest of the Full checklist could not be verified against the source.
issues.evidence: 'Trees and hedges within the application site or on adjoining properties, which are within falling distance of the proposed development'; 'A schedule/layout of homes'

issues.detail: BNG and Ecological Survey are listed under Non-material amendment. Statutory BNG does not apply to s96A non-material amendments, so either this NMA PDF holds template text or the item is misread.
issues.evidence: NMA row: 'If the Statutory Biodiversity Metric has been used to evidence a measurable net gain, the applicant must ... submit a biodiversity net gain assessment'

issues.detail: Rows taken from the Full Planning Permission checklist are labelled 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. That note is inaccurate, because the source document itself is application-type specific.

summary: The live source could not be fetched because the WebFetch and WebSearch budgets were exhausted, so link and date currency are unverified and the date rests only on PDF metadata. Structurally, the Listed building consent rows come from the s73 checklist, the per-type checklists for Householder, Outline, LBC and Advert were never read but those types are marked national-only, the CIL requirement looks inapplicable, and most 'submission rules' are page boilerplate.
